mapper.insert: INSERT INTO voyage (voyage_number, carrier_code, carrier_name, ship_name, origin_unlocode, dest_unlocode, departure_date, arrival_date) VALUES (#{voyageNumber}, #{carrierCode}, #{carrierName}, #{shipName}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destUnlocode}, #{departureDate}, #{arrivalDate})

INSERT INTO carrier_movement (voyage_number, movement_seq, departure_unlocode, arrival_unlocode, departure_time, arrival_time) VALUES (#{voyageNumber}, #{seq}, #{departureUnlocode}, #{arrivalUnlocode}, #{departureTime}, #{arrivalTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE voyage SET departure_date = #{departureDate}, arrival_date = #{arrivalDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE voyage_number = #{voyageNumber}
mapper.select: SELECT voyage_number, carrier_code, carrier_name, ship_name, departure_date, arrival_date, origin_unlocode, dest_unlocode, status FROM voyage WHERE voyage_number = #{voyageNumber}
SELECT voyage_number, carrier_code, carrier_name, ship_name, departure_date, arrival_date, origin_unlocode, dest_unlocode, status FROM voyage ORDER BY registered_at DESC
SELECT departure_unlocode, arrival_unlocode, departure_time, arrival_time FROM carrier_movement WHERE voyage_number = #{voyageNumber} ORDER BY movement_seq
